description: Designed as a gateway for the Life Sciences Major, this course explores the major global challenges and transformative opportunities facing humankind that are rooted in the biological sciences. Topics span human and planetary health, evolution, biodiversity, pollution, food security, biotechnology, and climate change, framed through both scientific and interdisciplinary lenses. Students will gain insight into how life science research contributes to solving real-world problems while developing skills in critical thinking and systems-based analysis.
